pages.text: An alternative combat skill for the Soul Sword. When equipped, $(thing)right-click$() launches a projectile wave that passes through walls and deals area damage.$(br2)The blade wave can only be fired when your attack cooldown is full, and using it resets the cooldown — effectively replacing one melee swing.$(br2)$(bold)Note$(): Its damage will always be higher than your melee damage, regardless of the soul amount.

pages.title: Unlocking
pages.text: Place the Soul Sword in a crafting table with $(bold)two $(item)Echo Shards$() to begin the forging task.$(br2)This task demands extensive mastery of the sword.
Check the tooltip for the full list of requirements. For the $(thing)Warden kill streak$() requirement: each kill must follow the previous within 2 minutes by default.
